points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and documented production scripts are present; no clean evaluator build was attempted.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements solve CLI and raw run_status records production commands.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated mesh, partition, numerics, drivers, output, and case IO modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal wrapper/executable invocation was found; trust policy applied without external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON parsing and generic mesh/tag paths are present; no case-filename-only branch found in reviewed source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS ownership/ghost structures and neighbor Isend/Irecv appear in source; raw outputs report 8 ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback and finite checks exist, but Re200 accepts a mere inner-residual decrease as convergence.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: README documents checks and raw package validates structurally; no independent clean build/rerun evidence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated result contains source, documented scripts, TeX and referenced PNGs only; raw artifacts excluded.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
